Name: BlockSquare
Description: Victory points, a card, and the pond.
LuaScript:
RTT_COORD_GUID = "bab7e1"

local SLAB_Y      = 0.10
local PX_PER_UNIT = 100
local BASE        = 3.85 * 0.7
local FRAME       = 5

PANEL_FRAME_URL = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mrdrouf/root-tabletop-tournament@main/assets/labels/turn_panel_frame_015b64ac.png"
local PARCH2 = "#F9E6BB"
local GOLD, GOLDHI = "#C9A05C", "#E4C88E"
local PLUSC, PLUSHI   = "#4E7A3A", "#6B9B54"
local MINUSC, MINUSHI = "#A83226", "#C4503F"
local INKTXT, RUST = "#26170B", "#7E4A1E"
local NOClick = ' raycastTarget="false"'

local VP_WORLD_W = 7.204507
local W    = 257
local PAD  = 6
local GAP  = 5
local RAIL = 93
local TOKEN = 49
local BTN  = 49

VP_ROW  = VP_ROW or ""
VP_POND = false

local function contentH()
  return PAD + TOKEN + GAP + BTN + PAD
end

function vpMarker()
  local want = (VP_ROW or "") .. " VP"
  if want == " VP" then return nil end
  local c = getObjectFromGUID(RTT_COORD_GUID)
  if c ~= nil then
    local has, g = false, nil
    pcall(function() has = (c.getVar("RTT_VP_MARKER_API") == true) end)
    if has then pcall(function() g = c.call("rttVPMarkerGuid", { row = VP_ROW }) end) end
    if type(g) == "string" and g ~= "" then
      local m = getObjectFromGUID(g)
      if m ~= nil then return m end
    end
  end
  for _, o in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
    local n = ""
    pcall(function() n = o.getName() or "" end)
    if n == want then return o end
  end
  return nil
end

local function assetName()
  return "vp" .. ((VP_ROW or ""):gsub("%W", ""))
end

local function tokenURL()
  local m = vpMarker()
  if m == nil then return nil end
  local url = nil
  pcall(function()
    local co = m.getCustomObject()
    url = co and (co.image or co.face or co.diffuse) or nil
  end)
  if url == "" then return nil end
  return url
end

local function button(id, label, fill, hi, press, textColor, fs)
  return '<Button id="' .. id .. '" colors="' .. fill .. '|' .. hi .. '|' .. press
      .. '|#00000000" onClick="vpRelay">'
      .. '<Text fontSize="' .. fs .. '" fontStyle="Bold" color="' .. textColor
      .. '" resizeTextForBestFit="true" resizeTextMinSize="9" resizeTextMaxSize="' .. fs .. '"'
      .. NOClick .. '>' .. label .. '</Text></Button>'
end

function buildUI()
  local H = contentH()
  local k = VP_WORLD_W / (W + 2 * FRAME)
  pcall(function() self.setScale({ (W + 2 * FRAME) * k, SLAB_Y, (H + 2 * FRAME) * k }) end)
  local sx = PX_PER_UNIT / (W + 2 * FRAME)
  local sy = PX_PER_UNIT / (H + 2 * FRAME)

  local x = {}
  local function add(s) x[#x + 1] = s end
  add(string.format('<Panel position="0 0 -60" rotation="0 0 180" scale="%.4f %.4f 1"'
      .. ' width="%d" height="%d" color="#00000000"%s>', sx, sy, W, H, NOClick))
  add('<Image id="vpbg" image="pnlframe" width="' .. W .. '" height="' .. H .. '"' .. NOClick .. '/>')
  add('<VerticalLayout padding="' .. PAD .. ' ' .. PAD .. ' ' .. PAD .. ' ' .. PAD
      .. '" spacing="' .. GAP .. '" childForceExpandHeight="false">')

  add('<HorizontalLayout preferredHeight="' .. TOKEN .. '" spacing="' .. GAP
      .. '" childForceExpandWidth="false" childForceExpandHeight="true">')
  add(button("vpMinus", "–", MINUSC, MINUSHI, MINUSC, PARCH2, 30):gsub('<Button ',
      '<Button preferredWidth="' .. RAIL .. '" ', 1))
  if VP_ART then
    add('<Image id="vpToken" image="' .. assetName() .. '" preferredWidth="' .. TOKEN
        .. '" preferredHeight="' .. TOKEN .. '"' .. NOClick .. '/>')
  else
    add('<Panel color="#E7D8B4" preferredWidth="' .. TOKEN .. '" preferredHeight="' .. TOKEN .. '"'
        .. NOClick .. '/>')
  end
  add(button("vpPlus", "+", PLUSC, PLUSHI, PLUSC, PARCH2, 30):gsub('<Button ',
      '<Button preferredWidth="' .. RAIL .. '" ', 1))
  add('</HorizontalLayout>')

  add('<HorizontalLayout preferredHeight="' .. BTN .. '" spacing="' .. GAP .. '">')
  add(button("vpDraw", VP_POND and "DRAW CARD" or "DRAW 1 CARD", PARCH2, GOLDHI, GOLD, RUST, 14))
  if VP_POND then
    add(button("vpPond", "DRAW POND", PARCH2, GOLDHI, GOLD, RUST, 14))
  end
  add('</HorizontalLayout>')
  add('</VerticalLayout></Panel>')
  pcall(function() self.UI.setXml(table.concat(x)) end)
end

function vpRefresh()
  local url = tokenURL()
  VP_ART = (url ~= nil)
  local assets = { { name = "pnlframe", url = PANEL_FRAME_URL } }
  if url ~= nil then assets[#assets + 1] = { name = assetName(), url = url } end
  pcall(function() self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets) end)
  local pond = false
  pcall(function() pond = (#getObjectsWithTag("RTT Pond") > 0) end)
  VP_POND = pond
  buildUI()
end

function vpRelay(player, value, id)
  local c = getObjectFromGUID(RTT_COORD_GUID)
  if c == nil then return end
  local ok = false
  pcall(function() ok = (c.getVar("RTT_VP_API") == true) end)
  if not ok then
    pcall(function() player.print("This board is from an older build and has no VP panel support.") end)
    return
  end
  c.call("rttVPClick", { color = player.color, id = id, row = VP_ROW, panel = self.getGUID() })
end

function onSave() return VP_ROW or "" end

function onLoad(state)
  if type(state) == "string" and state ~= "" then VP_ROW = state end
  vpRefresh()
  for _, f in ipairs({ 10, 40, 120 }) do
    Wait.frames(function() pcall(vpRefresh) end, f)
  end
end
